title: General Applicant
description:
We are always excited to connect with those interested in joining us on our mission to squash industrial emissions. Whether you are looking for a full-time role or internship, drop us a line! If a role opens up and you are a good fit, we will be in touch!

About Sesame Sustainability

At Sesame Sustainability we are developing simulation, optimization, and analysis software to accelerate cost-optimal decarbonization across heavy industry (responsible for over 40% of global emissions). Borne from research at the MIT Energy Initiative, our technology stack is tried, tested, and trusted by some of the largest players in energy and environment.

Questions? Contact us at info@sesamesustainability.com
